business_definition: Unique reference for a customer relationship
why_critical: Basis for customer counts and KYC coverage

business_definition: Segment of the customer: Individual, Small Business or Large Enterprise
why_critical: Drives segment exposure and concentration reporting

business_definition: Unique reference for an account held by a customer
why_critical: Joins balances and loans to customers

business_definition: Product type of the account (for example Savings, Checking, Business)
Lifecycle state of the account: Active, Inactive or Closed
why_critical: Determines which balances count as live

business_definition: Ledger balance of the account at the extract date
why_critical: Headline balance KPI and liquidity view
Account age and loan date checks

business_definition: Unique reference for a posted transaction

why_critical: Assigns activity to the correct reporting period

business_definition: Nature of the transaction: Deposit, Withdrawal, Transfer or Payment
Value of the transaction in GBP
Account and customer the loan is booked against
why_critical: Links credit exposure to customers and segments

business_definition: Repayment state of the loan: Active, Overdue or Paid Off
Original principal advanced under the loan
Date the loan was drawn down
Contractual maturity date of the loan
